subject: Prospect reprioritizes LLM plan; request to hold demo
messages:
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.example.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@farsideanalytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — propose Wed 8/4 or Thu 8/5?

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our call, I put together a short deck outlining the inference cost/latency tradeoffs and a proposed POC timeline. Would either Wed 4 Aug at 10:00am PT or Thu 5 Aug at 1:00pm PT work for a 45-minute demo + Q&A?

Agenda (30 min demo, 15 min Q&A):
- Quick intro & goals
- Redwood architecture that matters for latency/cost
- Live run: embedding + chat flow on a 5k-user example
- Next steps & POC logistics

Attaching the deck and a draft SOW so your procurement can see a rough budget. If those slots don't work, tell me what your calendar looks like next two weeks and we'll adapt.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Solution_Deck_v2.pdf (PDF, 6 slides)]
[Attachment: Proposed_POC_SOW.docx (DOCX, draft)]

From: Maya Singh <maya@farsideanalytics.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.example.com>
Cc:  
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — propose Wed 8/4 or Thu 8/5?

Sergio —

Thanks for this and for sending the materials. The deck looks useful. I need to be upfront: leadership reallocated a portion of our ML budget to an analytics platform migration this quarter, and the LLM/inference work is deprioritized for the next 6–8 weeks.

Can we pause scheduling the live demo for now and keep Farside on your waitlist? If possible, please keep the SOW and deck on file and I’ll flag when we re-open the initiative.

Apologies — I know this is not ideal timing. I’ll reach back out when priorities shift back toward ML inference.

Best,
Maya
Head of ML Platforms, Farside Analytics

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.example.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@farsideanalytics.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.example.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — propose Wed 8/4 or Thu 8/5?

Maya —

Totally understand — thanks for the transparency. We'll move Farside to our demo waitlist and mark the deck/SOW as "on hold." Two quick notes:

1) Would it be OK if we check back in six weeks? If a short cadence is better (e.g., every 3 weeks), tell me and we’ll set a lightweight reminder.
2) If it helps procurement or leadership later, we can offer an internal credit for a small proof-of-concept (e.g., 1 week of reserved capacity) to shorten evaluation time once you re-open. No pressure — just an option.

If you prefer, I can loop in our CS lead to provide a temporary sandbox so your engineers can evaluate without scheduling a full demo. Monica, can you drop a one-off sandbox link and a short Onboarding README we can leave open for Maya?

Thanks again — we’ll set a follow-up reminder for six weeks unless you tell us otherwise.

— Serg
Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.example.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@farsideanalytics.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio@redwood.example.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2027 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — propose Wed 8/4 or Thu 8/5?

Hi Maya —

Totally understand on the reprioritization. I provisioned a lightweight sandbox for Farside that will stay active for 8 weeks — it includes:
- Preloaded sample dataset (anonymized)
- Demo prompt templates we used in the deck
- Short README with quick commands to run embedding and chat tests

Link: https://redwood-sandbox.example.com/onboarding/FS-8391
Temporary creds will expire 2027-09-25. If you want extended access later we can re-provision.

If useful, I can run a 20-minute async walkthrough (recording + notes) so your team can self-serve; otherwise we’ll wait for your signal to rebook a live session.

Warmly,
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
